title: How Much of the Price Band a Vehicle's Cover Standing Leaves Open
content:
What the Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment on a vehicle shows about claims decides how much of the price band is open to that Keyturn Vehicle Listing. What is counted is the claims filed on that enrolment in the rolling twenty-four months counted back from the handling date.

- A vehicle whose host protection enrolment shows two or more claims filed in that window has 0.75 of the band open to it, three quarters.
- A vehicle whose enrolment shows exactly one claim filed in that window has 0.9 of the band open to it, nine tenths.
- Any other vehicle has the whole band open to it.

### Points of judgement

*Where the count divides.* At 2 claims filed in the window the first clause governs; at exactly 1 the second; at none the third. A vehicle with 5 claims filed in the window is still on the first clause.

*What is counted.* Claims filed on the enrolment, by the date they were filed, over the rolling twenty-four months counted back from the handling date. A claim filed twenty-six months back is outside the window.

*Worked on a hypothetical figure.* A figure of 240.00 USD taken through a share of 0.75 stands at 180.00 USD; the same figure taken through 0.9 stands at 216.00 USD.
